summary: PWA installability tested on preview URL. manifest.json valid (name 'Jurnal Keuangan Hakusa Edu Japan', display standalone, start_url '/', icons 192/512 all 200 image/png). index.html has rel=manifest, apple-touch-icon loads, theme-color #1E3A8A, title 'Jurnal Keuangan | Hakusa Edu Japan'. service-worker.js served 200 as application/javascript and registers (navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations length = 1 on both initial load and after reload). SW correctly skips /api requests (code: early-return when url.pathname.startsWith('/api')). After admin login (admin@hakusa.id), visible desktop 'Pasang di HP' install button (data-testid=install-app-btn) opens install-help-dialog with install-help-android steps (headless Chrome does not fire beforeinstallprompt, so help dialog path exercised as expected). Sidebar brand uses /icon-192.png (loaded, naturalWidth 192). Mobile 390px: mobile-menu-btn opens sheet, visible install-app-btn clickable, help dialog shows readable Android steps.

issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (non-blocking). DialogDescription is present but Radix may still warn; verify DialogDescription is correctly linked.

critical_code_review_comments: service-worker.js correctly bypasses /api (good). Consider also bypassing cross-origin and non-GET explicitly (already handled).

InstallApp.jsx uses module-level deferredPrompt and global window listener registered at import time — fine, but note the component renders twice (desktop sidebar + mobile sheet) so clicking either triggers the same flow; count=1 was observed because only the visible instance mounts (desktop sidebar hidden on mobile and vice versa).
Minor: Radix Dialog a11y warning about missing aria-describedby could be fixed by adding id to DialogDescription or passing aria-describedby to DialogContent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA scope all green: manifest, SW registered and bypasses /api, install button + help dialog on desktop and mobile, brand icon loads. Only a minor Radix a11y console warning on DialogContent. Note: fetch('/api/auth/me') returned 401 inside page.evaluate even after login because httpOnly cookies are present but SameSite behavior in headless may differ; user remained on '/' after reload (not redirected to login) indicating auth state preserved via app logic — not a PWA issue.
